'''Micae's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Garth (city)|Garth]] in the [[North Country]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. The wife of [[Terandi]] and [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Micae]], she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] invasion of Garth during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]].
